Name: (CP) Warp Totems to Spells in Bags
Author: joiinks
Description:
This mod is pretty simple, it does what it says -- it's an item replacer for all totem items, perfect for a near-vanilla experience. All totem items are now castable spell bags that the player consumes by throwing on the ground.

Personally I found the totem imagery to be a bit unnecessary in general, so without breaking the vanilla immersion, I've opted for something else magical that also has precedent in items like fairy dust. The swirl design is inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7788]Ancestral Trees[/url].

The config options also allow for the Rain Totem and Treasure Totem to be disabled if desired, but they are all enabled by default. Let me know of any bugs in the reports if you find any, and happy farming :).

Pairs well with mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7788]Ancestral Trees[/url] and [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/1032927-pelican-town-potluck]Pelican Town Potluck[/url].
